scope.includes: Aspect, basic, Team-Up, player side scheme and resource/reprint cards outside the previous 39-face hero audit.

method: Deterministic solo and two-player scenarios through the real game loop, controllers, rendered choices, resource payments and timing windows. Puzzle commands establish board and deck states; card behavior is not mocked. Includes actual attacks, defenses, thwarts, searches, healing, defeat, phase and round transitions.

validation.counting: Distinct unittest methods; subcases and reruns are not counted again.

runs.failure: Old Leather Jacket fixture used a response-card selector to choose basic defense. The tightened helper correctly no longer selects basic powers as responses.

runs.correction: Select the actual Defense option explicitly; all original gameplay assertions remain intact.

validation.reproduce: .venv-release\Scripts\python.exe -X utf8 -m unittest unit_test.test_jj_luke_first_pass unit_test.test_jj_engine_support unit_test.test_jj_hero_gameplay unit_test.test_luke_hero_gameplay unit_test.test_jj_luke_nemesis_gameplay unit_test.test_jj_luke_multiplayer_gameplay unit_test.test_form_change_lifecycle unit_test.test_overkill_damage_modifiers unit_test.test_bulletproof_belle_boost_damage unit_test.test_resource_cost_reduction unit_test.test_kingpin_side_scheme_reveals unit_test.test_fear_no_evil_player_cards unit_test.test_fear_no_evil_modular_sets unit_test.test_wonder_man_jarvis unit_test.test_thwart_target_restrictions unit_test.test_attached_identity_restrictions unit_test.test_attached_health_flip unit_test.test_optional_choice_confirmation unit_test.test_end_phase_hand_limit unit_test.test_v18_timing_integration unit_test.test_purple_man_obligation_readiness unit_test.test_sense_enemy_defeat unit_test.test_attack_defender_player unit_test.test_victory_defeat unit_test.test_jj_player_cards_gameplay unit_test.test_luke_player_cards_gameplay unit_test.test_jj_luke_shared_player_gameplay -q

fixes.name: Spider-Woman
fixes.issue: Declining the optional discard still fell through to discarding her.
fixes.fix: Use the explicit optional-choice factory with a Cancel option, retaining gained limb counters when declined.

fixes.name: Joys of Life
fixes.issue: A union passed directly as the exhaustion-cost selector admitted noncharacters, including the main scheme.
fixes.fix: Use an explicit Hero-or-Ally CardFinder for that cost.

fixes.name: Defend Our City
fixes.issue: The Team-Up discount stopped applying after the defeated scheme left play.
fixes.fix: Allow the temporary cost reduction to operate out of play until phase-end cleanup.

fixes.name: Valkyrie
fixes.issue: Printed Toughness was missing from metadata.
fixes.fix: Register Toughness so actual paid play gives her a Tough status card.

fixes.name: Righteous Purpose
fixes.issue: The support used an upgrade attachment play path, raising an AttachTo2 error.
fixes.fix: Use normal support play under any player's control, including its one-per-player check.

sources.use: Exact printed text transcribed in the existing experimental pack metadata; retained per face in this audit.
Publisher confirmation that Defend Our City's prerequisite refers to the identity's Defender trait, and Joys of Life's Alliance permits other players to pay exhaustion costs.

limits: Headless real-engine gameplay; no manual browser interaction or artwork rendering validation in this pass.
Targeted solo/two-player scenarios, not exhaustive combinations across every hero, scenario, campaign or multi-villain setup.
Additional scenarios reuse earlier coverage for Run Them to Ground, Grapnel Launcher and Mitigated Threat.
The packs remain opt-in experimental content; normal data/cards.json is unchanged.

cards.name: * Captain Marvel
cards.printed_text: Response: After Captain Marvel enters play, discard the top 4 cards of your deck. If you discard a printed [energy] resource, remove 2 threat from a scheme. If you discard more than one printed [energy] resource, also confuse an enemy.
cards.coverage: Zero, one and two printed energy icons; a double-resource card counts both icons; threat removal and confuse threshold.

cards.name: * Spider-Woman
cards.printed_text: Response: After a character you control thwarts, place 1 limb counter here (to a maximum of 8). You may discard Spider-Woman to deal 1 damage to an enemy for each limb counter here.
cards.coverage: Hero, ally and event thwarts; counter cap; optional discard accepted and declined; other-player and confused-thwart exclusions.

cards.name: * Squirrel Girl
cards.printed_text: Response: After you play Squirrel Girl from your hand, place 1 squirrel counter here for each card in your hand (to a maximum of 4). Action: Remove 1 squirrel counter from here → remove 1 threat from a scheme.
cards.coverage: Hand size after payment, four-counter cap, no entry reward when simply put into play, repeated counter actions without exhausting.

cards.name: Lay Down the Law
cards.printed_text: Hero Response (thwart): After you change form, remove 3 threat from a scheme (4 threat instead if you paid for this card using a [mental] resource).
cards.coverage: Paid form-change response with and without the mental-resource bonus.

cards.name: Strategy Session
cards.printed_text: Alter-Ego Action: Choose a player to search their deck for a player side scheme and add it to their hand. Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a player side scheme.
cards.coverage: Hero thwart targets player side schemes; alter-ego searches own or chosen teammate's deck and adds the result to that player's hand.

cards.name: * Run Them to Ground
cards.printed_text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Resolve each of the following: • Skip the next villain phase. • Deal each player 1 facedown encounter card (immediately). • The villain cannot take damage until the start of the next (unskipped) villain phase.
cards.coverage: Whole villain phase skipped; each player receives an immediate encounter card; villain immunity lasts through skipped phases until an actual villain phase starts.

cards.name: * Lay the Trap
cards.printed_text: Victory 0. When Defeated: The player who defeated this scheme deals 5[per_hero] damage to the villain.
cards.coverage: Defeat reward deals five damage solo and ten with two players.

cards.name: Determination
cards.printed_text: Max 1 per deck. Hero Response: After you spend this card, remove 1 threat from the main scheme.
cards.coverage: Resource payment removes one main-scheme threat only in hero form.

cards.name: Grapnel Launcher
cards.printed_text: Restricted. Hero Action: Discard this card → make a basic thwart without exhausting (even if you are exhausted). For this thwart, your hero gets +1 THW and ignores the patrol keyword and any crisis icons ([crisis]) in play.
cards.coverage: Granted basic thwart while exhausted or ready, +1 THW, confusion, Patrol/Crisis bypass, additional basic-power costs and cleanup.

cards.name: Entrapment
cards.printed_text: Max 1 per player. Alter-Ego Response (attack): After the villain schemes, change to hero form and discard this card → deal damage to the villain equal to the amount of threat placed by that activation.
cards.coverage: Form change and discard costs precede attack; damage equals threat placed; blocked form change, stunned identity and confused villain cases.

cards.name: * Hellcat
cards.printed_text: If your identity has the [[Defender]] trait, this card gains: "Action: Put Hellcat into play from your hand. At the end of the phase, discard her."
cards.coverage: Free Defender action versus normal paid play; alter-ego restriction; only the free entry expires at phase end.

cards.name: Joys of Life
cards.printed_text: Alliance. Action: Choose: • Exhaust a [[Civilian]] alter-ego → ready a hero or ally. • Exhaust a hero or ally → ready a [[Civilian]] alter-ego.
cards.coverage: Both exhaust/ready choices; alliance payment with another player's hero; schemes are excluded from character exhaustion costs.

cards.name: Unbreakable Bond
cards.printed_text: Team-Up (Jessica Jones and Luke Cage). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. Heal a total of 3 damage from among Jessica Jones and Luke Cage.
cards.coverage: Both printings; 3/0 and 2/1 healing, teammate identity, paid thwart, confusion replaces the whole thwart and missing-partner restriction.

cards.name: * Second Chance
cards.printed_text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Each player may shuffle all of their identity-specific cards from their discard pile into their deck.
cards.coverage: Defeat shuffles all eligible identity cards, excludes aspect/basic cards, and allows declining the reward.

cards.name: * Defend Our City
cards.printed_text: [star] Hinder 1[per_hero]. Prerequisite ([[Defender]]). Victory 0. When Defeated: Each player may search their deck and discard pile for a Team-Up card and add it to their hand. Until the end of the phase, reduce the cost to play each Team-Up card by 1.
cards.coverage: Identity prerequisite, Hinder scaling, both players search, discount persists after defeat and ends at phase end.

cards.name: Innate Aggression
cards.printed_text: Starting. (You may add this card to your hand before drawing your starting hand.) Your hero gets +1 ATK.
cards.coverage: Hero ATK bonus and cleanup; optional Starting selection before the opening draw, including decline.

cards.name: Shakedown
cards.printed_text: Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player. Response: After you attack and exactly defeat a minion, exhaust this card → remove threat from a scheme equal to that minion's base SCH.
cards.coverage: Exact attack defeat versus excess/nonattack damage, base SCH reward, exhaustion, other-player control and max one per player.

cards.name: Innate Perception
cards.printed_text: Starting. (You may add this card to your hand before drawing your starting hand.) Your hero gets +1 THW.
cards.coverage: Hero THW bonus and cleanup; Starting selection leaves the correct six-card opening hand.

cards.name: Innate Inspiration
cards.printed_text: Starting. (You may add this card to your hand before drawing your starting hand.) Each ally you control gets +1 hit point.
cards.coverage: Existing and newly entering owned allies gain health; teammate allies are excluded; cleanup and Starting selection.

cards.name: * Echo
cards.printed_text: Reduce the amount of damage Echo takes from each enemy attack by your hero's DEF.
cards.coverage: Enemy attack damage reduced by current hero DEF, including Leather Jacket; nonattack damage is unaffected.

cards.name: * Lay Low
cards.printed_text: Victory 0. When Defeated: Each player may change to alter-ego form. Heal damage from each alter-ego equal to its REC.
cards.coverage: Optional form change and healing by REC, including an existing alter-ego when another hero declines to flip.

cards.name: Mitigated Threat
cards.printed_text: Attach to a card. Attached card loses each [acceleration], [amplify], [crisis], and [hazard] icon. Forced Response: At the end of the round, each player may spend 1 resource of any type. If any player does not, discard this card.
cards.coverage: Paid attachment play; dynamic icon removal, stacking, blanking/reattachment cleanup, every-player upkeep and skipped-villain-phase upkeep.

cards.name: * Iron Fist
cards.printed_text: Interrupt: When Iron Fist defends against an enemy attack, prevent damage from that attack equal to Iron Fist's ATK.
cards.coverage: Actual ally defense prevents enemy attack damage; nonattack damage still applies.

cards.name: * Misty Knight
cards.printed_text:
Toughness.
[star] Misty Knight gets +2 ATK and +2 THW while she has a tough status card.
cards.coverage: Entry Toughness grants +2 ATK/THW; consequential damage removes Tough without harming the ally; reapplying Tough restores the bonus.

cards.name: * Valkyrie
cards.printed_text: Toughness. Interrupt: When another ally would be defeated, discard Valkyrie (from play) → instead heal that ally until they have 1 hit point remaining.
cards.coverage: Paid entry Toughness, accepted/declined defeat replacement, lethal and consequential damage, self exclusion and teammate ally rescue.

cards.name: Take a Stand
cards.printed_text: Hero Response: After your hero defends, each ally you control gets +1 THW and +1 ATK until the end of the player phase.
cards.coverage: Paid response after actual hero defense; player-phase expiration and persistence through a villain phase into the following player phase.

cards.name: Innovation
cards.printed_text: Max 1 per deck. Hero Response: After you spend this card, heal 1 damage from an ally you control.
cards.coverage: Resource payment heals an owned ally only in hero form.

cards.name: The Power of Leadership
cards.printed_text: Max 2 per deck. Double the number of resources this card generates while paying for a Leadership (blue) card.
cards.coverage: One card pays a two-cost Leadership support; remains a single wild resource when paying another aspect.

cards.name: Defensive Formation
cards.printed_text: Uses (3 block counters). Action: Exhaust this card and remove 1 block counter from it → give a [[Defender]] ally a tough status card.
cards.coverage: Three counters, exhaustion, final-use discard, Tough target restrictions and another player's Defender ally.

cards.name: Righteous Purpose
cards.printed_text:
Play under any player's control. Max 1 per player.
Each character you control that has exactly 1 hit point remaining gets +2 THW and +2 ATK.
cards.coverage: Normal paid support play under either player; max one per player; exact-one-HP stat changes, healing, form changes and removal cleanup.

cards.name: * Hulk
cards.printed_text: Hulk gets +1 ATK for each rage counter here. Response: After the villain attacks you, place 1 rage counter here.
cards.coverage: Rage after own villain attack, no rage for minion or other-player attacks, modified ATK and two consequential damage.

cards.name: * She-Hulk
cards.printed_text: Toughness. Response: After She-Hulk enters play, give your identity a tough status card.
cards.coverage: Entry Toughness and optional additional Tough for Luke's identity.

cards.name: Dynamic Duo
cards.printed_text: Action: Search your deck and discard pile for a Team-Up card and an ally named by that card's Team-Up keyword. Add those cards to your hand. (Shuffle.)
cards.coverage: Real searches of deck/discard find the new Team-Up and its named ally and add both to hand.

cards.name: Power Man and Iron Fist
cards.printed_text: Team-Up (Iron Fist and Luke Cage). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action (attack): Deal 2 damage to an enemy and give a tough status card to a character.
cards.coverage: Attack and selected character Tough, including an enemy; missing partner restriction and stun replaces the whole attack.

cards.name: Unbreakable Bond
cards.printed_text: Team-Up (Jessica Jones and Luke Cage). Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. Heal a total of 3 damage from among Jessica Jones and Luke Cage.
cards.coverage: Linked Unbreakable Bond printing: paid three-threat removal and three healing; shared script distribution and multiplayer cases.

cards.name: Energy
cards.printed_text: Max 1 per deck.
cards.coverage: Energy pays a two-cost support using its two printed energy resources.

cards.name: Genius
cards.printed_text: Max 1 per deck.
cards.coverage: Genius pays a two-cost support using its two printed mental resources.

cards.name: Strength
cards.printed_text: Max 1 per deck.
cards.coverage: Strength pays a two-cost support using its two printed physical resources.

cards.name: Size Advantage
cards.printed_text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy (6 damage instead if you have the [[Giant]] trait or more remaining hit points than that enemy).
cards.coverage: Strict remaining-health comparison including equality; Giant trait overrides the comparison.

cards.name: Observe
cards.printed_text: Hero Action: The villain schemes. Give your hero a tough status card.
cards.coverage: Villain schemes, then identity receives Tough; confused villain cancels scheming without preventing the subsequent Tough.

cards.name: Toughen Up
cards.printed_text: Response: After you recover, if your remaining hit points are equal to or greater than your base hit points, exhaust Toughen Up → give your identity a tough status card.
cards.coverage: Basic REC reaching base HP, insufficient recovery and nonbasic healing exclusions, and base-versus-increased-maximum HP.

cards.name: Black Belt
cards.printed_text:
Play only if any player controls a [[Martial Artist]] card.
Attach to a friendly character. Max 1 per character.
Attached character gets +1 hit point and gains the [[Martial Artist]] trait.
cards.coverage: Martial Artist prerequisite can come from another player's card; +1 HP and trait persist across forms; cleanup and one-per-character limit.
